verdict.rationale: NerdGraph GraphQL API and CLI expose query, alerting, dashboard, and SLO configuration, but New Relic's own docs state NerdGraph lets you 'configure some New Relic features' — explicitly not full UI parity. No evidence every UI workflow (e.g., full dashboard builder, entity management edge cases) is API-exposed, and openapi probes 404 confirming no fully documented spec of complete surface. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of 1:1 API/UI feature parity, comprehensive OpenAPI spec, and independent verification of coverage gaps.
